card.name: Mixed: mg after dose numbers, PLAN test
card.fires_on: Mostly the unit mg right after a dose number in dosing sentences, and the word PLAN in a passage about PLAN/ACT/SAT tests. Also fires on the start of Cervical and on a few other words such as mice or injection.

modes.label: mg after a dose number
modes.description: The unit mg directly after a number in a recommended dosage statement.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of REPATHA is either 140<< mg>> every 2 weeks OR 42

modes.label: PLAN test name
modes.description: The word PLAN naming the pre-ACT school test.
modes.example: The<< PLAN>> Test Results The PLAN test is best

modes.label: Cervical
modes.description: The first part of the word cervical, split as Cerv and ical, in cancer or resistance headings.
modes.example: 5.8 Cerv<<ical>> Resistance The pharmacologic action of ZOLA
